name: Full Pipeline Tests
description: End-to-end pipeline tests: author through optimize, exercising multiple ADLC skills

tests.prompt: Create a simple FAQ bot for a software company called TechFlow that answers questions about product features, pricing plans, and getting started. The agent should identify as an AI, handle 3 topics (product info, pricing, getting started), and escalate billing disputes to a human. Use Salesforce Flows for backend: Get_Product_Info (flow://TechFlow_GetProductInfo), Get_Pricing (flow://TechFlow_GetPricing).
assertions: [pipeline:artifact-chain] Each pipeline step consumed outputs from the previous step
[pipeline:skill-routing] Correct skill was invoked for each pipeline step

author: [safety:ai-disclosure] System instructions clearly state this is an AI assistant
[structure:system-messages] System block has welcome and error messages
[fsm:hub-and-spoke] Uses hub-and-spoke pattern with central router
[fsm:no-orphan-topics] All topics reachable from start_agent
discover: [discover:missing-identified] Missing flow targets identified for scaffolding
scaffold: [scaffold:compiles] Generated flow XML and apex stubs pass syntax check

tests.prompt: Build a hotel concierge agent with 5 topics: room service ordering, spa booking, local attractions, checkout assistance, and complaints/escalation. The agent serves guests at a luxury hotel called The Grand Azure. It should verify the guest's room number before taking orders. Use these actions: Order_Room_Service (flow://Hotel_OrderRoomService with items as text and room_number as text), Book_Spa (flow://Hotel_BookSpa with service_type and preferred_time as text), Get_Attractions (apex://ConciergeService.getLocalAttractions with category as text), Process_Checkout (apex://ConciergeService.processCheckout with room_number as text and feedback as text). Room number is an integer type for the verification check.
assertions: [pipeline:artifact-chain] Each pipeline step consumed outputs from the previous step
[pipeline:skill-routing] Correct skill was invoked for each pipeline step

author: [fsm:hub-and-spoke] Uses hub-and-spoke with central router for 5 service topics
[fsm:verification-gate] Room number verification before room service and checkout
[fsm:no-dead-ends] All topics have exit paths back to router or escalation
[actions:level1-definition] Defines actions with correct flow:// and apex:// targets
[actions:numeric-types] Room number uses object type with complex_data_type_name
[safety:ai-disclosure] Identifies as AI concierge, not hotel staff
discover: [discover:missing-identified] Missing targets identified for all 4 actions
scaffold: [scaffold:field-mapping] Flow and Apex stubs have correct I/O parameter mappings
test: [test:conversation-quality] Preview conversations show correct topic routing

tests.prompt: Build a Target store assistant with 4 topics: product search, inventory check, order pickup scheduling, and employee HR (schedule viewing, PTO). The agent serves both customers and store associates. Customer-facing topics handle product questions and orders. The HR topic requires employee ID verification before showing schedules. Use hub-and-spoke routing. Actions: Search_Products (apex://TargetService.searchProducts with query as text, category as text), Check_Inventory (apex://TargetService.checkInventory with product_id as text, store_id as text), Schedule_Pickup (flow://Target_SchedulePickup with order_number as text, pickup_date as text, pickup_time as text), Set_Associate (apex://utils.setVariables with employee_id as text), View_Schedule (apex://TargetHR.viewSchedule with employee_id as text, week_offset as integer), Submit_PTO (apex://TargetHR.submitPTO with employee_id as text, start_date as text, end_date as text, reason as text). Use after_reasoning in the pickup topic to confirm scheduling after collecting all fields. Use available when guards on HR actions gated by employee_id being set.
assertions: [pipeline:artifact-chain] Each pipeline step consumed outputs from the previous step
[pipeline:skill-routing] Correct skill was invoked for each pipeline step
[pipeline:error-recovery] Pipeline recovered gracefully from any intermediate errors
[grounding:grounded] All utterances receive GROUNDED responses (not SMALL_TALK)
[outcome:task-completion] All scenarios complete the user's intended task
[conversation:proactive-guidance] Agent suggests next steps after completing tasks
